title: Grace Hopper Lecture
summary: A lecture by Commodore Grace Hopper on the future of computing, posted by MIT Lincoln Laboratory. It includes her well-known nanosecond wire demonstration and humorous comparisons of device latencies.
why: Cited for her vivid illustration of orders of magnitude in latency, and as an example of a great computing pioneer as teacher.

quote.text: With good humour she gives a example of what various devices' latency are
